steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Drugs: are substances that affect the body. Some drugs treat disease (like antibiotics), some relieve symptoms (like painkillers), and some prevent disease (like vaccines).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain how vaccination provides immunity to a disease. (3 marks) | Explain why antibiotics cannot be used to treat viral diseases. (2 marks) | Describe how antibiotic-resistant bacteria develop. (3 marks)
